reviews.title: Next generation of building your own enterprise applications
reviews.pros:
-Low-code platform to build your enterprise application

-Starts with a blank doc so you can type regular text and formulas too

-Tables act more like databases, allowing you to connect data easily

-Large set of examples on their template gallery (www.coda.io/templates)

-Automations is a feature that lets you easily automate repetitive steps in your workflow
reviews.cons: Nothing major at the moment. Sometimes the performance may slow down if you have a lot of data, but this is prevalent in any SaaS application where you store thousands of rows of data.
reviews.overall: Amazing platform that is trailblazing in the no-code/low-code space. Brings the power of application building to regular business users in your enterprise.
